title: Recall cloud concepts from requirements
summary: Infer the cloud concept from requirements, without choices. Existing facts keep their original progress identities; all fifteen concepts remain covered.

iaas.clue: A workload needs customer-controlled operating-system patches and kernel settings on rented compute. Which service-model abbreviation fits?

paas.clue: A team deploys its own source code to a supported runtime while the provider operates the guest operating system. Which service-model abbreviation fits?

saas.clue: A department adopts a complete vendor-maintained business application and configures its users rather than deploying application source. Which service-model abbreviation fits?

public-cloud.clue: A provider offers its cloud services for general purchase by unrelated organizations. Name the deployment model.

private-cloud.clue: An offsite cloud environment is dedicated to one organization, even though a third party hosts it. Name the deployment model.

hybrid-cloud.clue: A company connects its dedicated cloud environment to generally available provider services and operates them together. Name the combined deployment model.

consumption-based.clue: A team rents capacity and pays according to resource usage instead of buying a fixed server estate. Name the pricing model, including the word model.

serverless.clue: An event handler runs on a platform that provisions and maintains its servers; the team supplies code, not server administration. Name this execution model, without assuming a particular billing plan.

capex.clue: A company pays up front to purchase physical servers it will own. Name the expenditure category in full.

opex.clue: A company accounts for ongoing service consumption over time rather than acquiring physical infrastructure. Name the expenditure category in full.

high-availability.clue: The design objective is to keep a service available when disruptions occur. Name the cloud benefit concerned with uptime.

reliability.clue: After a failure, a distributed system recovers and continues working. Name the cloud benefit concerned with recovery.

predictability.clue: A team forecasts expected performance and service spending from usage evidence. Name the cloud benefit concerned with knowing these outcomes in advance.

horizontal-scaling.clue: A web tier changes its number of same-sized instances. Name the scaling axis rather than the increase/decrease direction.

vertical-scaling.clue: An existing machine changes CPU and memory capacity while the instance count stays fixed. Name the scaling axis rather than the increase/decrease direction.
